protocol.procedure: Analyze public failure logs to detect oscillation and coverage gaps. Use memory of best practices and failures to guide dynamic task routing in branch-and-dispatch workflows. Prioritize deadline adherence and intervention efficiency.

parent.procedure: Use public failure evidence to propose one reusable branch-and-dispatch workflow. Respect the DSL grammar.

candidate.procedure: Analyze public failure logs to identify oscillation patterns. Prioritize coverage gaps and deadline violations. Generate a branch-and-dispatch workflow that dynamically routes tasks based on diagnostic signals while preserving memory of best practices and failures.
